headline: Nevish Line Reignites as Colonials Breach Moltworth in Viper Pit
war_summary: Since the morning dispatch, the previously dormant Nevish Line has erupted into fierce contention, logging nine strategic base transfers over the past two hours across Princefal, Tomb Father, and surrounding redoubts. In Viper Pit, the grinding attritional storm finally altered the map as Colonials wrested control of Moltworth, suffering and inflicting nearly one thousand casualties in the two-hour push. High-casualty friction continues unabated along the northern front; Callahan’s Passage absorbed nearly two thousand combined losses and three base shifts while remaining unified under Warden administration, whereas Weathered Expanse bled over twenty-three hundred men without yielding a single base alteration. Farther west, Fisherman’s Row recorded six rapid exchanges with negligible bloodshed, leaving two island positions ruined in no-man's-land. Mooring County maintained steady friction with three shifts around The Wind Hills, while Stlican Shelf decelerated to a solitary transfer as no-man's-land was eliminated to leave the hex divided three bases to six.
